const raw = $input.first().json || {}; const body = raw.body && typeof raw.body === 'object' ? raw.body : raw;
const command=$('Prepare Compare And Acknowledge').item.json.ack;if(body.ok!==true||body.orderId!==command.orderId||body.requestId!==command.requestId)throw new Error('SHEET_ACK_UNCONFIRMED');return [{json:{ok:true,newerRequestPreserved:body.newerRequestPreserved===true}}];

const raw = $input.first().json || {}; const body = raw.body && typeof raw.body === 'object' ? raw.body : raw;
const expected=$('Validate Canonical Status Event').item.json;const receiptRevision=body.revision;const validRevision=typeof receiptRevision==='string' && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(receiptRevision)) && (receiptRevision===expected.statusRevision || (body.ignored==='STALE_REVISION' && Date.parse(receiptRevision)>Date.parse(expected.statusRevision))); if(body.ok!==true||body.orderId!==expected.orderId||body.eventId!==expected.eventId||body.mirrorStored!==true||!validRevision)return [{json:{httpStatus:503,responseBody:{ok:false,error:'STATUS_MIRROR_UNCONFIRMED'}}}];return [{json:{httpStatus:200,responseBody:{ok:true,orderId:expected.orderId,eventId:expected.eventId,statusRevision:expected.statusRevision,mirrorStored:true,...(body.ignored?{ignored:body.ignored}:{}),duplicate:body.duplicate===true}}}];
